subtitle: A chilled, still orange and passion fruit blend for non-drinkers and anyone who prefers a smooth, sweet soft drink.
quickAnswer: J2O Orange & Passion Fruit costs a typical {price}, contains {calories} kcal and is served chilled in a glass bottle. Prices vary by pub. This non-carbonated fruit juice blend combines sharp orange with sweeter passion fruit, making it a useful choice if you prefer a still drink with your food.

components.name: Orange
components.note: Orange brings the sharp, zesty tang that balances the sweeter passion fruit in this smooth juice blend.

components.name: Passion fruit
components.note: Passion fruit adds tropical sweetness, giving the drink its rounded, full-bodied flavour alongside the sharper orange.

taste:
J2O Orange & Passion Fruit tastes sweet and fruity, with a sharp orange tang balanced by tropical passion fruit. The orange gives it a zesty edge rather than leaving sweetness as the only impression. Passion fruit rounds out that sharper note, producing a full-bodied blend. Its texture is thick and smooth, so this is a drink to choose for a substantial fruit flavour rather than a fizzy sensation.

Served chilled in a glass bottle, it has an orange colour and no carbonation. That still texture suits anyone who dislikes bubbles. Alongside a spicy dish such as chicken jalfrezi, the chilled, sweet fruit blend offers a refreshing contrast between mouthfuls.

bestFor.title: A still drink
bestFor.text: This is a good fit for anyone who wants a cold soft drink without carbonation. Its smooth, thick texture makes the absence of bubbles part of the appeal.

bestFor.title: With spicy food
bestFor.text: The chilled fruit blend suits a spicy meal such as chicken jalfrezi. Sweet passion fruit and zesty orange provide a refreshing contrast to the food between mouthfuls.

bestFor.title: Non-drinking diners
bestFor.text: A glass bottle of this fruity soft drink suits non-drinkers who want something sweet and full-bodied with their meal, rather than choosing an alcoholic option.
